faces.name: Geomancer's Gambit
faces.oracleText:
Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
Draw a card.

faces.name: Geometer's Arthropod
faces.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with {X} in its mana cost, look at the top X cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Geometric Nexus
faces.oracleText:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, put a number of charge counters on this artifact equal to that spell's mana value.
{6}, {T}, Remove all charge counters from this artifact: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of charge counters removed this way.

faces.name: Geometric Weird
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, you may have Geometric Weird's base power and toughness each become equal to the greatest number of spells and abilities from different sources that were on the stack simultaneously that turn.
